hero.title: Math without the stress: build exam confidence, one lesson at a time
hero.lead: One-to-one lessons for middle and high school students, online or in person. We focus on your specific gaps—not repeating the whole curriculum.

about.title: About me
about.sub: A little about who you'll learn with and how I work.
paragraphs: I'm Anna. I have a degree in mathematics and have spent nine years helping students build confidence and prepare for exams.
We start by identifying knowledge gaps, then create a personal plan with short weekly check-ins. Parents receive a concise progress update each month—no surprises when exam day arrives.
Lessons are available online or in person. Your first 30-minute introductory session is free.

results.title: Student results
results.sub: Sample outcomes from the previous year—not promises.

items.t: 14 of 18 students scored 75 or higher. The top score was 96, up from 54 at the start.
All 11 students passed, including three who made significant progress over six months.
Two students placed in a regional mathematics olympiad. These sample results do not guarantee admission benefits.

plans.title: Pricing
plans.sub: Three ways to learn. Monthly plans offer flexibility if you need to miss a lesson.

items.name: Exam prep
features: If you don't reach your target, June lessons are free

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: Select a question to see the answer.

items.q: Are online lessons as effective as in-person ones?
items.a: Yes. I use a digital writing tablet, so students can follow every step just as they would on a whiteboard. With permission, lesson recordings are available to revisit. Most of my students learn online.

items.q: What if we're not a good fit?
items.a: The first 30-minute introductory session is free and comes with no obligation. If it doesn't feel right, I'll say so and can recommend another tutor.
Plans are billed monthly. If you need to miss a lesson, let me know at least a day ahead and we'll reschedule it.
